query: Civiqs daily tracker Trump approval disapproval latest

results.content:
President Donald Trump’s job approval rating in Alabama remains above water, though it has declined from the high point he reached at the start of his second term, according to the latest tracking data from Civiqs.

The survey shows 53% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 40% disapprove. Another 8% said they neither approve nor disapprove. [...] The latest figures mark a modest improvement from early July, when 52% of Alabama voters approved of Trump’s job performance, 41% disapproved and 7% were unsure or held no opinion.

However, Trump’s standing remains below where it was at the beginning of his second term.

According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. [...] At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net approval rating of -10. His current net rating of -23 leaves him 13 point
